description: What your agents are doing on all your machines: one line per session with its state, health, how long it has been quiet and its summary, under its machine and project. Use it first when asked how the work is going, or what is running where. Pass project to see one project's sessions only. Beyond 200 rows it pages. Answers take a few seconds: other machines are asked at their next refresh.

page.description: The page of rows to show, from 1 (default 1).

project.description: Only this project's sessions, by the name gruntas_status lists it under.

name: gruntas_status
